name: graphql-api
title: GraphQL API
blurb: GraphQL Yoga on Node: SDL schema, typed resolvers, depth-limited queries, in-process yoga.fetch() tests and a real socket check
default_description: A GraphQL API with a schema-first SDL and query depth limits.

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
PORT=5441 node dist/server.js >.graphql.log 2>&1 & srv=$!
ok=1
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  if curl -fsS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"query":"{health{status}}"}' http://127.0.0.1:5441/graphql >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .graphql.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi
health=$(curl -fsS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"query":"{health{status}}"}' http://127.0.0.1:5441/graphql)
stats=$(curl -fsS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"query":"query($t:String!){stats(text:$t){text lines words bytes}}","variables":{"t":"hello world\n"}}' http://127.0.0.1:5441/graphql)
deep=$(curl -fsS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"query":"{a{b{c{d{e{f{g}}}}}}}"}' http://127.0.0.1:5441/graphql)
missing=$(curl -fsS -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"query":"{stats{bytes}}"}' http://127.0.0.1:5441/graphql)
badvar=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"query":"query($t:String!){stats(text:$t){bytes}}"}' http://127.0.0.1:5441/graphql)
kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null
printf '%s' "$health" | grep -q '"status":"ok"' \
  && printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"lines":1' \
  && printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"bytes":12' \
  && printf '%s' "$deep" | grep -q 'QUERY_TOO_DEEP' \
  && printf '%s' "$missing" | grep -q 'is required' \
  && test "$badvar" = 400
